newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN QUICK TACKLE DUTCH MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN QUICK TACKLE DUTCH MARKET.

text.p: Belgian hamburger restaurant chain Quick NV said on Friday it plans to tackle the Dutch fast food market.
Quick, which is market leader in Belgium and number two in France, plans to open 50 to 70 new hamburger restaurants in the Netherlands between now and the year 2002.
"We need to achieve a critical mass there," Quick chief executive officer Thomas Meisser told a news conference about 1996 earnings.
Quick has a 60 percent share of the number of visitors in Belgium and 25 percent in France. If the Dutch plan is successful, it would have a 25 to 30 percent market share there in five years.
Quick said today that 1996 net profit plunged 48 percent to 321 million francs. Last year, the group opened 54 new restaurants, bringing its total to 371.
At the end of 1996, the group had 105 restaurants in Belgium, 258 in France, five in the Netherlands and three in Luxembourg.
